product_overview: Aplicación de gestión de usuarios con autenticación JWT y una API REST para registro, login, perfil y cambio de contraseña. Incluye además un CRUD administrativo de usuarios con control de acceso por rol y borrado lógico.
core_goals: Permitir registro, autenticación y gestión del perfil del usuario con JWT.
Proteger las rutas según sesión y rol, diferenciando usuarios normales y administradores.
Ofrecer a administradores un CRUD completo de usuarios con búsqueda, filtros, paginación y borrado lógico.
Garantizar validaciones de negocio para contraseñas, unicidad de email y consistencia de errores JSON.

features.name: Health check
features.description: Endpoint público para verificar que la API está operativa.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with {"status":"ok"}
GET /api/unknown-health -> Receive 404 with {"error":"Ruta no encontrada"}

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Registro público, inicio de sesión y gestión del perfil y contraseña del usuario autenticado mediante JWT enviado en el header x-token.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/registro with valid nombre, email and strong password -> Receive 201 with token and usuario role "usuario" -> GET /api/auth/perfil with x-token -> Receive 200 with authenticated usuario profile
POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with token and usuario -> PUT /api/auth/perfil with x-token and updated nombre/email -> Receive 200 with updated usuario
POST /api/auth/registro with weak password -> Receive 400 with validation errors
POST /api/auth/login with unknown email or wrong password -> Receive 401 with "Credenciales inválidas"
GET /api/auth/perfil without x-token -> Receive 401 with missing/invalid/expired token error
PUT /api/auth/password with x-token, correct passwordActual and valid new password -> Receive 200 with {"mensaje":"Contraseña actualizada"}
PUT /api/auth/password with x-token and incorrect passwordActual or new password equal to current -> Receive 400 with password validation or current-password error

features.name: User administration CRUD
features.description: CRUD administrativo para listar, crear, consultar, actualizar y eliminar usuarios con control de acceso por JWT y rol admin.
user_flows: GET /api/usuarios with valid admin x-token and default pagination -> Receive 200 with total, pagina, limite, totalPaginas and usuarios array
GET /api/usuarios?buscar=ana&rol=usuario&pagina=1&limite=10 with valid admin x-token -> Receive 200 with filtered and sorted usuarios list
GET /api/usuarios without x-token -> Receive 401 with missing/invalid/expired token error
GET /api/usuarios with authenticated non-admin x-token -> Receive 403 with role access denied error
POST /api/usuarios with valid admin x-token and user data -> Receive 201 with created usuario and hashed password stored
POST /api/usuarios with authenticated non-admin x-token -> Receive 403 with role access denied error
GET /api/usuarios/:id with valid admin x-token and existing active id -> Receive 200 with usuario details
GET /api/usuarios/:id with valid admin x-token and invalid Mongo id -> Receive 400 with invalid id error
PUT /api/usuarios/:id with valid admin x-token and partial updates -> Receive 200 with updated usuario
PUT /api/usuarios/:id with valid admin x-token and password empty -> Receive 200 with usuario and unchanged password
PUT /api/usuarios/:id with admin attempting to change own rol -> Receive 400 with self role change error
DELETE /api/usuarios/:id with valid admin x-token and another user's id -> Receive 200 with mensaje "Usuario eliminado" and logically deleted usuario
DELETE /api/usuarios/:id with admin attempting to delete own account -> Receive 400 with self deletion error
DELETE /api/usuarios/:id for an already deleted or nonexistent user -> Receive 404 with not found or already deleted error

features.name: Global error handling
features.description: Consistent JSON error responses for unknown routes and invalid requests across the API.
user_flows: ANY /api/* with a nonexistent route -> Receive 404 with {"error":"Ruta no encontrada"}
POST /api/auth/registro with malformed JSON body -> Receive 400 with invalid JSON body error
PUT /api/auth/perfil with invalid or missing fields -> Receive 400 with validation errors

features.name: Health check
features.description: Public endpoint used to verify that the API is running.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Public registration and login, plus authenticated profile and password management. Login returns a JWT that must be sent in the x-token header.

endpoints.description: Public registration. Always creates a user with rol "usuario"; a supplied rol is ignored. Password must be 8-64 chars with uppercase, lowercase and a digit. Email must be unique.

response_schema.400: validation errors (email duplicate, weak password, missing fields)

endpoints.description: Login with email and password. Unknown email, wrong password and inactive user are rejected; unknown email and wrong password share the message "Credenciales inválidas".

response_schema.401: missing, invalid or expired x-token, or inactive user

endpoints.description: Updates the authenticated user's nombre and/or email. Email uniqueness ignores the user's own current email.
Changes the authenticated user's password after checking passwordActual. The new password must differ from the current one and follow the password rules.

response_schema.400: wrong current password, new password equal to current, or validation errors

features.name: User administration CRUD
features.description: Admin-only CRUD for users. Every route requires a valid x-token and rol "admin"; missing token returns 401 and a non-admin authenticated user returns 403.

endpoints.description: Lists active users (estado true) with pagination. Optional buscar searches nombre/email case-insensitively, rol filters by role, pagina defaults to 1 and limites defaults to 10 (max 50). Results are sorted by nombre.
Returns one active user by Mongo id.

response_schema.404: user not found or logically deleted

endpoints.description: Creates a user with a hashed password. rol defaults to "usuario" and accepts "admin" or "usuario".
Partially updates a user. An empty/absent password leaves the password unchanged. An admin cannot change their own role.

response_schema.400: validation errors, invalid id, or self role change
response_schema.404: user not found or logically deleted

endpoints.description: Logical deletion. Sets estado=false; the user stops appearing in listings and can no longer log in. An admin cannot delete their own account.

response_schema.404: user not found or already deleted

features.name: Global error handling
features.description: Returns consistent JSON errors for unknown routes, invalid JSON bodies, duplicate emails and validation failures.

known_limitations.issue: Deletion is logical, so a deleted user's email still occupies the unique index and cannot be reused for a new registration.
known_limitations.impact: Registering the email of a logically deleted user returns a duplicate-email validation error.

known_limitations.issue: No rate limiting or account lockout on login.
known_limitations.impact: Repeated login attempts are not throttled.

known_limitations.issue: Tokens are not revoked on logout because logout is handled only by the client removing localStorage.
known_limitations.impact: A copied JWT remains valid until it expires.

known_limitations.issue: USUARIOS_DEMO in the seed is only used by the manual npm run seed command, not on every start.
known_limitations.impact: Test accounts exist only if the seed command was run against the current database.
